To control cost, your in-context conversation is periodically dropped and you resume in a fresh session with no memory of your own reasoning — only your workspace files survive. log.txt survives but is large and raw: it records every board and action, not the conclusions you drew from them, so a fresh session relying on log.txt alone re-derives and re-tests rules you already settled, wasting actions and cost.
